name: ListNovate AI
author: Futurrnovate

sections.description:
Ever spent hours uploading products manually? While your team or CRM resources are tied up writing descriptions, setting prices, and formatting listings instead of serving customers or closing sales? That’s where ListNovate AI comes in.

Creating WooCommerce products one by one can be tedious and prone to errors. ListNovate AI changes that by giving you a dedicated staging area right in your WordPress dashboard.

Instead of dealing with the native WooCommerce upload screen for every single item, you can upload your images, let AI write your titles and descriptions, make bulk edits, and then push everything to your live store with a single click.

Key Features:

  • Image-First Creation: Start by simply uploading individual images or entire image folders as in our guide (https://listnovate.futurrnovate.com/docs#staging).
  • Smart AI Content: Let AI automatically write your product titles, short and long descriptions, and SEO copy, and auto-assign taxonomies and attributes based on the product image, store context, and your custom settings.
  • Product Staging Area: Review your drafted products in a clean grid or list view before they ever hit your live store.
  • Bulk Editing: Save time by updating categories, tags, pricing, and attributes for multiple products at once.
  • Seamless Publishing: Supports simple and variable products, complete with stock status and variations, straight to your WooCommerce catalog.
  • Custom AI Voice: Fine-tune the AI’s tone, target audience, and keywords in settings so the generated content matches your brand.

External Services

This plugin connects to external APIs hosted at listnovate.futurrnovate.com to provide core functionality. Below is a detailed breakdown of when and why data is transmitted:

  1. AI Generation & Processing (ListNovate AI Engine)

    • What it is: Connects to our external server to process AI requests, generate product metadata and content, and handle active add-on operations that cannot be performed locally.
    • What data is sent: Product prompts, settings configuration, and relevant metadata when an AI generation or processing request is triggered by the user.
    • Terms of Service: https://listnovate.futurrnovate.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://listnovate.futurrnovate.com/privacy

  2. Deactivation Feedback

    • What it is: Connects to our API to submit optional user feedback when the plugin is deactivated.
    • What data is sent: The feedback text entered by the user, sent only if the user explicitly submits the deactivation modal form.
    • Terms of Service: https://listnovate.futurrnovate.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://listnovate.futurrnovate.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugins screen or upload the .zip file.
  2. Activate ListNovate AI.
  3. Go to WordPress Admin → ListNovate AI to enter your API key and configure your preferences.
  4. Ensure WooCommerce is active and start staging your products.
sections.faq:
Does ListNovate AI require WooCommerce?

Yes! Since it is built specifically to streamline your WooCommerce catalog, you will need WooCommerce active on your site to use it.

How do I generate AI product content?

Go to the ListNovate AI menu, add your API key, and configure your preferred settings. From there, select your products in the staging area and click to generate their content.

Can I bulk edit products before I upload them?

Absolutely. The staging workspace lets you select multiple items to update attributes, categories, and other details all at once before you publish them.

Will this slow down the front end of my store?

Not at all. The workspace runs entirely inside your WordPress admin dashboard, so your customers’ shopping experience won’t be affected.
